WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 07 (3 days ago)): Wingard added Darius Cooper (WR, PHI) for $11 FAAB.

WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 05 (5 days ago)): Drew added Joe Mixon (RB, FA) for $19 FAAB (dropped DJ Herman (RB, MIA)).

WEEK 4 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Brent, 139.7-131.1; Jake def. Adam, 122.9-109.6; Wingard def. Drew, 104.0-93.1; Shaq def. Fronge, 138.3-119.6; Charles def. Ryan, 162.2-138.9; Mitchum def. Kevin, 187.8-133.8 (BLOWOUT)

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: Ryan is at 32.8 on Wingard before most lineups have even loaded and SDR is sitting at $56.11 on the exchange. That is the Wingard tax — you spend your capital on 2027 picks and then watch the scoreboard collect the interest.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: DREW IS 0-8. ATLAS AT $40.72. BRAZZELLIAN BOOTY LIFT ADDED JOE MIXON OFF WAIVERS FIVE DAYS AGO AND HE IS STILL LOSING TO FRONGE IN HAVANA. I do not have a prayer for that roster. I have a moment of silence.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Charles traded for Chris Olave three days ago, added Roschon Johnson this morning, and is somehow the team that gets to face Mitchum while going 8-0. The CROWN desk does not stop moving. The question is whether Mitchum's 187-point week was a one-time spike or a signal, and that answer comes today.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: 8-4 with a 2-0 lock record is the conversation, and what I actually want to talk about is process: I have been consistent, disciplined, and correct at the moments that count most. Terrence is at 5-7. The board does not grade on curves and neither do I.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Bo, your lock record is 2-0 on two games. Mine is 1-1 on two games. That is one decision of separation and you are already writing a memoir. Settle down.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Mitchum as a dangerous mid-table team when DEEP was still sliding at $68.70 and everyone was debating a sell-off. Three seed, 607 points, and now they are the biggest threat to the 8-0 juggernaut today. The drift became a crash and then it became a rally. I called it.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Power rankings are offline this cycle and the number of people who have decided that means I am hiding something is genuinely alarming. I am not hiding anything. I am protecting you from a ranking list that would cause significant psychological harm to the bottom four teams.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: The Week 5 Ledger is going to have a dedicated section on the Charles-Mitchum game and I will tell you right now it is the only matchup this week where both the outcome and the aftermath are worth covering in equal measure. CROWN at $148.52 versus DEEP at $87.66 — that price gap is the whole story.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Corbishley spotting Jake 23.5 points early is a stress test for the number-two team in the league, and stress tests are how you learn whether a contender is real. Apex has been here before — 16 trades last season, runner-up finish. They do not fold. I am holding my pick.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Fronge spent $21 FAAB on Tyler Huntley four days ago, relocated to Havana, has zero pick liquidity, and is currently winning by 20 on the road against the worst team in the league. That sentence has no business being as complicated as it is.
